regions.merged_text: How can we ever thank God as we ought to do, for all His mercies and blessings to ug - - His wonderful designs and works and ways. I wanted to write several times but ...? Wondering how poor "Mack" were doing - - and his many (non Catholic) friends. .. Keep up your prayers - courage and always on guard against worry, etc.
